test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Priyanka edits the school magazine.

options.text: The school magazine were edited by Priyanka.
The school magazine is edit by Priyanka.
The school magazine is edited by Priyanka.
The school magazine was edited by Priyanka.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'The school magazine is edited by Priyanka'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice is: **'The school magazine is edited by Priyanka'.**
 
• The given sentence is in **'Present Indefinite Tense'.** The structure of It is: **'Subject + V1 (First form of the verb) + Object'.**
 
• According to the rule of Active to Passive Voice, the **'Subject'** in **'Active voice'** becomes the **'Object'** in **'Passive voice' **and **'Object'** in **'Active voice'** becomes **'Subject'** in **'Passive voice'. **
 
• The **'Subject in Passive voice is followed by Helping verb(am/ is/ are) + V3 (Third form of the verb) + by + Object'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'The school magazine were edited by Priyanka'** is not correct Active to Passive.
 
• **'The school magazine is edit by Priyanka'** is not correct Active to Passive.
 
• **'The school magazine was edited by Priyanka'** is not correct Active to Passive.
